mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stop_application (schedule_id, doctor_id, apply_reason, status, chief_review_status, approve_comment, approved_by, approve_time, affected_count, refund_total, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{doctorId}, #{applyReason}, #{status}, #{chiefReviewStatus}, #{approveComment}, #{approvedBy}, #{approveTime}, #{affectedCount}, #{refundTotal}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stop_application WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PENDING_ADMIN') FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM stop_application WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stop_application WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT * FROM stop_application WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY create_time DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE stop_application SET status = #{status}, approve_comment = #{approveComment}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approve_time = SYSDATE, affected_count = #{affectedCount}, refund_total = #{refundTotal}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE stop_application SET chief_review_status = #{chiefReviewStatus}, status = #{status}, chief_review_comment = #{chiefReviewComment}, chief_reviewed_by = #{chiefReviewedBy}, chief_review_time = SYSDATE, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
